title: FCFS CPU Scheduling Algorithm
question: WAP to simulate FCFS CPU Scheduling Algorithm.
theory: First Come First Served scheduling executes processes in the order in which they arrive in the ready queue. It is simple and non-preemptive, but short jobs may wait behind long jobs.
algorithm: Sort the processes according to arrival time.
If the CPU is idle, move time to the next arriving process.
Run the selected process until its burst time completes.
Calculate completion time, turnaround time, waiting time, and the averages.

title: FIFO Page Replacement Algorithm
question: WAP to simulate FIFO Page Replacement Algorithm.
theory: FIFO page replacement removes the page that entered memory first. It is simple to implement with a circular pointer or queue.
algorithm: Scan the reference string one page at a time.
If the page is already in a frame, count a hit.
If the page is absent, replace the oldest loaded page and count a fault.
Move the replacement pointer after every fault that replaces a frame.
